# Centrifuge Solvent Guide

Guidance on which solvent to use when cleaning centrifuge components.

## Approved Solvent

The approved solvent for routine centrifuge cleaning is 70% ethanol. Apply it
with a lint-free cloth and wipe every accessible surface of the rotor and
chamber. Do not substitute other alcohols without sign-off from lab operations.
